text: Encryption scrambles data so only key holders can read it. Symmetric encryption uses one shared key for locking and unlocking. Asymmetric encryption uses a public key to lock and a private key to unlock. TLS combines both to secure web traffic: asymmetric math exchanges a temporary symmetric key.
